visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Zoe, a female creator with long dark hair wearing a beige jacket, speaks directly to the camera in a brightly lit airport terminal. Behind her, large glass windows reveal a runway and a commercial aircraft with a blue-and-white tail under overcast skies. (2) Xiang, a male with short dark hair, leans into the frame next to Zoe. They both express excitement through animated facial expressions and gestures while standing in the spacious, modern airport lounge with yellow and green seating visible. (3) The scene cuts to Zoe pointing two fingers toward the camera as she continues her explanation. The indoor lighting is bright and even, highlighting her facial features as she talks with high energy and a wide smile. (4) Transitions show the interior of a commercial airplane cabin at night, followed by a window view of glowing city lights from high altitude. Xiang is later seen sitting in the cabin, looking tired yet smiling slightly. (5) Arriving at the airport, Zoe is shown walking through a modern terminal with a black suitcase. She meets Lid, a bearded man in a white t-shirt, and they share a friendly handshake and greeting in a brightly lit corridor. (6) Lid leads the creators to a Mobily telecom counter for SIM cards, then they are seen inside a car in a parking garage. The video captures a bustling mall at night with numerous local families and children under neon lights. (7) Creators share a pizza dinner with Lid at a restaurant called Sportions. The scene then shifts to a luxurious hotel suite with warm ambient lighting, elegant furniture, and a large bed, which the creators explore with delight. (8) A fast-paced montage features Zoe in traditional-style desert clothing walking through sand dunes, ancient stone ruins against a bright blue sky, and posing with a camel. The video ends with a shot of traditional dancers performing.

(5) [Variety]: (開啟北部人模式) [Subtitle]: 就說好啊~很好客. (6) [Subtitle]: 結果沒想到 他就開始安排行程了?!. (7) [Subtitle]: 他就說 他想帶我們出去玩 機票現在先買比較便宜. (8) [Subtitle]: 就問說我們能不能把護照資料給他 他幫我們買. (9) [Subtitle]: 阿翔問她 那我們第一天到機場 跟你在哪會合比較方便?. (10) [Subtitle]: 結果他就說 不用, 你只要換完Sim卡 他車跟住宿 都會幫我們準備好!?. (11) [Variety]: (還笑得出來?!) [Subtitle]: 詐騙園區的起手式嗎?!. (12) [Variety]: (已在機場) [Subtitle]: 反正我們現在就是 抱著忐忑的心情.. (13) [Subtitle]: 這我第一次做這麼長程 我覺得有點可怕... [Variety]: (飛行中...). (14) [Subtitle]: 利雅得 (沙烏地阿拉伯首都) 我們終於到達 將近花了10個小時... 全程花大概16小時左右 滿累的.... (15) [Variety]: 朋友本人 Lid [Subtitle]: 就這樣抱著忐忑的心情 終於跟朋友會面.... (16) [Subtitle]: 該沒想到第一步 還真的先被帶去買Sim卡. (17) [Variety]: (假裝鎮定地聊天) [Subtitle]: 忍不住偷偷問了一下Lid 到底我們要去哪裡? 我們要一起吃晚餐!. (18) [Variety]: (結果只是去吃晚餐?!) It uses the narrative hook of a potential 'scam' to create suspense before revealing the reality of their luxurious and hospitable experience.
